benchmark_text: Position axis for ACA enhanced premium tax credits. +2 = strongly supports extending the credits beyond their 2026-01-01 expiration. -2 = strongly opposes extension / explicitly supports expiration. 0 = mixed or non-committal.

Position axis for Medicare drug price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act. +2 = strongly supports expanding negotiation to more drugs / accelerating timeline. -2 = strongly opposes / supports repeal or narrowing. 0 = mixed.

Position axis for federal Medicaid funding and eligibility requirements. +2 = strongly defends funding levels and opposes work requirements / eligibility cuts. -2 = strongly supports cuts and / or work requirements. 0 = mixed.
Position axis for drug importation from Canada and similar markets. +2 = strongly supports expanding legal importation pathways. -2 = strongly opposes / cites safety as reason to block. 0 = mixed.

Position axis for federal regulation of health insurers (denials, prior authorization, network adequacy). +2 = strongly supports tighter federal regulation. -2 = strongly opposes / prefers market-based solutions. 0 = mixed.
